what: Hovering a list row or pill shows a 240×180 photo panel 20px right of and below the cursor. It stands up in .4s expo.out from 120% below with a 50° twist (the inner photo from the opposite −120% · −50°), while the photo settles from 2× to 1× over .7s. Moving the pointer makes the panel follow the cursor. On leave, the panel slides up to −120% · −5° and the photo down to 120% · 5° · 1.2× over .6s expo.out and disappears. Off below 992px and on touch

options.min: Minimum window width to light up (px), default 992
options.[data-fx-part=pic]: Photo slot to float on the panel (child) — hidden normally and moved into the panel

use: Field 1

from.where: list.html field pills · shared.js footer offices (original HoverImgFx3 — .work__filters-item·.footer__office, fixed 240×180 panel, cursor +20px)
